name: stage3a_terminal_utility_v1
scope: evaluator-only labels; no weight, ground-truth outcome, or terminal utility is exposed to the online backend or policy observation

rationale.success_reward: A correct accepted pose is the primary task outcome.
rationale.cost_penalty_per_s: Measured online tool time is a soft efficiency preference, not a replacement for the hard action budget.
rationale.false_accept_penalty: One false accept is worse than a reasonable defer and prevents a cost-only Oracle from accepting unsafe candidates.
rationale.recovery_penalty_per_frame: A continuing reject streak represents delayed recovery in the sequential environment.
rationale.memory_pollution_penalty: An incorrectly accepted pose that is written to Memory receives an additional future-state penalty.
